checks.name: The file is YAML
checks.about: Each file can be read, and holds a YAML mapping of fields.

checks.name: The file says which version and view it is
checks.about: awml names a version this release reads, and a legacy view says it is security or platform.

checks.name: Every field is known and none is missing
checks.about: Each file, scope, part, line, implementation, block and comment has the fields it needs and no others, and each list is a list of mappings.

checks.name: Every kind is known
checks.about: Each part and line has a kind the spec defines.

checks.name: No id is used twice
checks.about: Scope, part, block and comment ids are unique across the file.

checks.name: Every id is well written
checks.about: An id is letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, and a block's platform is a company id, or in a 0.5 file owner/platforms/slug.

checks.name: Every value that should be text is text
checks.about: Ids, labels, kinds and references are text, not something YAML read as true, false, a number or a date.

checks.name: Every breaks is true or false
checks.about: A line's breaks, which draws it red, is true or false, unquoted.

checks.name: Every reference names something in the file
checks.about: Each in, from and to, each part a block names and each part a comment ties names a scope, block or part the file has.

checks.name: No scope or block is nested in itself
checks.about: Following in from any scope or block never leads back to it.

checks.name: A comment is linked only by tie lines
checks.about: A comment moves nothing, so only a tie, or a hidden line, may touch it.

checks.name: Every tie has a comment at one end
checks.about: A tie links a comment to what it explains, so one of its ends is a comment.

checks.name: Every op is known and on a step
checks.about: An op is one of the operations the spec lists, on an ai, code or person step.

checks.name: Only a do step leads to an outside action
checks.about: A step that leads to an outside action, straight or through a review or a fork, is a do step.

checks.name: An answer or check step never writes to a context
checks.about: An answer step and a check step read contexts and speak on surfaces, but never write to a context.

checks.name: Every outside action's label ends with its tier
checks.about: An outside action's label ends with Allow, Ask or Block after a colon.
checks.skippedBecause: no file given is a 0.5 workflow

checks.name: Every tier agrees with what stands in front of it
checks.about: An Ask action has a review, a standing approval or a person's own step on every way in, an Allow action has no review or standing approval in front of it, and only red lines lead to a Block action.
checks.skippedBecause: no file given is a 0.5 workflow

checks.name: Every standing approval lists its actions on a surface
checks.about: A standing approval leads to the surface where each action it covers is listed with how to undo it.
checks.skippedBecause: no file given is a 0.5 workflow

checks.name: Every data line stays in its scope or narrows
checks.about: A data line moves content only within its scope or into one inside it, since any other move is publishing drawn as routing.

checks.name: Every processing is well written
checks.about: A scope's processing is any, none, or a map from company ids to any or a list of known operations.

checks.name: An inner scope allows no more processing than its outer one
checks.about: A scope inside another allows no company or operation that the outer scope doesn't.

checks.name: Only a scope takes processing
checks.about: processing belongs to a scope, never to a block of the platform view.

checks.name: Only a block takes a platform
checks.about: platform belongs to a block of the platform view, never to a scope.

checks.name: Every wait is a duration on a trigger
checks.about: wait is an ISO 8601 duration in weeks, days, hours, minutes or seconds, given only on a trigger.

checks.name: Every at is a path on a context
checks.about: at is a relative path of plain names, given only on a context.

checks.name: No part is placed twice in an implementation
checks.about: Each part sits in at most one block of each implementation.

checks.name: Every part that needs a block has one
checks.about: Every part but a trigger or comment sits in a block of each implementation.

checks.name: No do step is decided by AI
checks.about: A do step should be code acting on what an earlier step decided; this warns and never fails.

checks.name: Each do step makes one change
checks.about: A do step should lead to one change, counting each outside action and surface and all contexts together as one; this warns and never fails.

checks.name: Every platform description value is of the right kind
checks.about: platform is a mapping, off_for_up_to a duration, steps code or agent, agents and calls lists of company ids, and holds a list.
checks.skippedBecause: no file given is a platform description

checks.name: Every company id and path is well written
checks.about: A platform description's ids and company ids are lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, a 0.5 description's id may be owner/platforms/slug, and what it holds are relative paths.
checks.skippedBecause: no file given is a platform description

checks.name: Both views have the same parts
checks.about: A legacy security view and platform view with the same title have the same parts, of the same kinds, apart from comments and triggers the platform view leaves out.
checks.skippedBecause: no sound security view and platform view share a title

checks.name: Both views have the same lines
checks.about: A legacy security view and platform view with the same title have the same lines by their ends and kind, apart from ties, hidden lines and lines to what the platform view leaves out.
checks.skippedBecause: no sound security view and platform view share a title
